vrDesc: Snapping pincers, bloody from the ant's last meal, lash out at you.  Although slow and nearly blind, ants have a keen sense of smell and a taste for human flesh.
There is a malevolent, otherworldly quality to this man.  He clings to the shadows of this vile place, a servant to some dark power.
Fierce warriors, these flightless bird men demand caution as you approach.  The plumage clearly denotes this Avar as being part of the noble Peet-Seeeep tribe.
Known for their noble grace, the Peet-Seeeep tribe efficiently controls the south-eastern shores of the island.  This clan leader is feared for its keen accuracy with a bow and deadly slasher.

This is a shaman of the Peet-Seeeep clan.  Legend says that the Shaman Avar blind themselves in order to force their third, 'magical' eye to sprout forth.  Only a fool would willingly offend one of these fearsome warlocks.
Lawless rogues that are known for their theft and burglary prey upon hapless travelers and soldiers alike.

vars.vrMercenaryJoin: Jorgan sent you here?  What are we waiting for, lets go...

vrDesc: Lawless rogues that are known for their theft and burglary prey upon hapless travelers and soldiers alike.  This bandit is ranked of a captain. It takes a strong, ruthless leader to keep a gang of bandits in line.

vars.vrMercenaryJoin: Jorgan sent you here?  What are we waiting for, lets go...

vrDesc: Lawless rogues that are known for their theft and burglary prey upon hapless travelers and soldiers alike.  Snipers are some of the most dangerous bandits, with accurate aim they will take you down from a far.

vars.vrMercenaryJoin: Jorgan sent you here?  What are we waiting for, lets go...

vrDesc: Whistling an inane tune to himself, Joguer takes great care in tending to his fresh garden of magical herbs and mushrooms. Many say he is the foremost herbalist in the land.

vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "I fear that I have no use for thy offering.  Mayhaps thou should seek to sell it at another establishment.~n~k"

vrDesc: At one time Meidei only served the rich or those who tipped well, until recently when he "found" Shal'ille.  Now a hard core believer, he almost drives his own customers away from his ale.

vars.vrUnwanted_keep: ~k%s%s tells you, "I thank thee for thy offering.  I shall distribute it to the poor and needy.~n~k"

vrDesc: Though well known throughout the land for his superb skill as a master weapon smith, Fehr'loi Qan himself could not be considered the sharpest sword on the rack.  The large man's slow speech seems out of place in the highbrow city of Barloque.  You get the impression that he is uncomfortable with strangers, but his great size and clear devotion to Kraanan makes him afraid of no one.

Of everyone in Barloque, the former sailor turned innkeeper Pritchett is the least haughty.  Perhaps it is because he was not originally from the Royal City and moved to North Barloque to buy a title.

vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "Whyfore dost you offer me that?~n~k"

vrDesc: Fancying himself a connoisseur of the finer things, Herbutte is little more than a old school aristocratic snob.  Within him is a dark streak of contempt for nearly all save royalty.  He will never run out of bad things to say about the other towns and the low life transients that wander between them.

vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "Wherefore dost thou offer to me such common baubles?!  I have servants who go to market to buy such things for me.~n~k"

vrDesc: Obert is a relatively handsome gentleman who takes almost as much pride in his vaults as he does in his family. His professional manner shows that he realizes his customers are often in a hurry to retrieve their goods.

vars.vrvaultman_nogold: Thou may not use my services to store %s%s.
vars.vrvaultman_fullvault: Thy vault cannot hold all that!  Mayhaps thou should try offering items in smaller quantities.
vars.vrvaultman_thanks_amount: That will cost %i shillings.  I thank thee for trusting me to quartermaster thy gear.
vars.vrvaultman_dont_have: Hmmm, I can't seem to find %s%s in thy vault.
vars.vrvaultman_no_room: Thou can not carry all of that!  Mayhaps thou should try withdrawing the items one at a time.

vars.vrvaultman_noaccount: I do not seem to be storing any of thy gear.
vars.vrvaultman_not_enough: Thou have not that many %s stored in thy name!

vrDesc: Used to working with the well refined tastes of nobility, Madelia meticulously oversees her craft. However, she often wishes to spend excessive time working on a single outfit for one of the more powerful and esteemed members of court. Madelia's other hobby is to play with the hearts of men and currently has several affairs in the works.

vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "Thou should seek a proper merchant to sell thy wares.~n~k"

vrDesc: The younger, prissy, and less competent brother of Paddock casually lounges behind the bar.  While sipping from goblet (pinky outstretched), he slowly bobs his head to the music.

A few scraps of rotten flesh cling to this collection of human bones topped by a battered and distinctly nonhuman skull.  Sizzling liquid drips from its teeth, leaving small pits in the ground below.You shudder to think what dark ritual brought this abomination into being.
Thought to be extinct, the beetle's large shiny exoskeleton clicks as it opens its dripping mandibles.  Although beetles have wings, their unnatural bulk renders them incapable of true flight.

A young man with pale skin and a slightly rounded figure stands before you.  His friendly smile almost makes you overlook his weak handshake, though it never quite reaches his eyes.  He keeps his customers' money securely behind heavy iron bars, and you get the sense he wants to know that every last one of their coins is in his grasp.
A cheerful, mischievous man with a beautiful singing voice, always heard at his forge.  Roderick is devoted to his craft, as shown by the calluses and burns on his hands.

The barkeeper seems out of place in his own pub.  His fine clothes are worn and were likely tailored for him in younger, slimmer days.  As you approach, the strong smell of booze fills the air while he rinses a pitcher with trembling hands and glassy eyes.

A tall, charismatic man of imposing stature.  King Aaron exudes natural leadership, and his confident presence inspires trust in those around him.  Rumors suggest he is merely a figurehead for powerful interests, but standing before him, it is difficult to believe anything but his authority.

A gaunt woman whose nervous eyes follow every customer who enters.  The cave's dim light conceals much of her weathered features, while the scent of exotic herbs lingers in the air.  Her tired smile hints at a beauty and youth now faded by hardship.

vars.vrBuyer_Unwanted: As if I'm interested in that.

vrDesc: With raised eyebrows and a welcoming smile, the older, lean warehouse manager regards you.  Dressed in a fine velvety tunic with noble trim and a serrated hem, he wears a belt with a gold drawstring and an ornate brooch.  His staff, topped with a gilded crocodile head and a blue tail, marks him as a careful steward of Berg's goods.

vars.vrVaultman_nogold: You lack the funds to store %s%s with me.
vars.vrVaultman_fullvault: Your vault cannot hold all of that.  Try offering items in smaller quantities.
vars.vrVaultman_thanks_amount: That will be %i shillings.  Thank you for trusting me to safeguard your gear.
vars.vrVaultman_dont_have: I cannot find %s%s in your vault.
vars.vrVaultman_no_room: You cannot carry all of that.  Try withdrawing items one at a time.
vars.vrVaultman_deposit_thanks: Thank you for trusting me to safeguard your gear.
vars.vrVaultman_thanks: Here is your gear.  Thank you for your patronage.
vars.vrVaultman_nowithdraw_cash: You do not have enough to pay the withdrawal fee.
vars.vrVaultman_nodeposit_cash: Storing these items would cost %i shillings, which you do not possess.
vars.vrVaultman_cant_part: I'm sorry, but I cannot be responsible for your %s.  I cannot store it.
vars.vrVaultman_noaccount: I do not appear to be storing any of your gear.
vars.vrVaultman_not_enough: You do not have that many %s stored here.

vrDesc: These creatures pounce and break down their enemies, dissolving all the organic materials before moving on to their next prey.  Slimes that have successfully taken the lives of several creatures alter in form and are far stronger than their unevolved counterparts.
Vicious and Vile, this Black Dragon drips death and  consumes souls.  Razor sharp claws, Daggers for teeth,  and an unimaginable rage against anyone who trespasses. Warrior Beware.
If you want to travel to the land beyond, Captain Seaborn charges a heavy price for such a luxurious experience.

vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~kCaptain Seaborn tells you, ''~B~rIf you want to travel on my boat, you need to buy a ticket. If you're not buying a ticket, get off my boat.~B~r''~k

vrDesc: These creatures are known to construct burrows consisting of many tunnels.  Despite their small bodies, they possess a frightening amount of strength.
Aw, look at the cute little bunny!
A captain of a once feared army, this knight is one to be avoided.
This dirty orc grunt wanders through the caves hungrily in search of gems and food.
Bright red plates make up the exoskeleton of this giant centipede.  Instinct, not intellect, guides its quest for nourishment.
A chupacabra

The Cibilo Creek Inn is a common gathering place for students and scholars from the nearby university, and often the site of debate on every manner of issue.  D'Franco is encouraging and tolerant of any good discussion, though his views tend to be somewhat conservative.
Mychel, the museum curator, has good attention to detail, and the concerns of his visitor.

A nobleman and former military officer, Rook carries himself with a stiff dignity.  He is a weaponsmaster, and makes a living passing his skills on to students of the warriors' path.  His feats with the sword are famous and unparalleled as is his love for a good drink.
Hester is from a very distant land, and her adept sewing reflects a distinct tradition that incorporates functionality with a powerful art.  The clothes she produces are beautiful.

This shop reflects the fine and exotic tastes of its proprietor.  Solomon has collected goods and art from unimaginable corners of the known world, and is rumored to have relics and artefacts from even beyond that.

Alchemists and farmers endeavored to breed the perfect cow for sweet milk and tender meat.  Unfortunately their experiments went too far and eventually created the utterly useless Pygmy Cow.  Disappointed by their failure, they let loose their entire herd.  The undomesticated pygmy cow is rarely seen any more.
The sight alone of this abomination of nature is often enough to paralyze a human.  You shudder to think what dark ritual brought this creature into being.

You can feel that you are in the presence of a powerful warlock.  Invasive magic weighs heavily in the air surrounding this wandering sorcerer.  His knowledge of the intricacies of spell learning is unsurpassed, though his public dislike for the temples has made him an outcast of the Royal Court.

vars.vrTeach_quest_needed: I do not teach my craft to just any parlor magician who stumbles by.  When you are ready, I will let you know.  Begone.

vrDesc: You are not sure who...or what it is your looking at. It claims it will store your souls for you. But I'm not sure if ''it'' can be trusted.

vars.vrLm_bnkr_did_deposit: You now have %i souls sealed away.
vars.vrLm_bnkr_no_account: There are no souls linked to your spirit.
vars.vrLm_bnkr_acct_full: You have to many souls bound to you, your spirit can not handle anymore.
vars.vrLm_bnkr_acct_almost_full: Your spirit is almost at its limit, it won't be able to bond with many more souls.
vars.vrLm_bnkr_not_enough_withdraw: You only have %i souls bound to you.
vars.vrLm_bnkr_not_enough_deposit: You only have %i souls in your possession.
vars.vrLm_bnkr_did_withdraw: Here are your %i souls. I hope you treat them better than I have.
vars.vrLm_bnkr_player_full: The wieght of %i souls is to much for your mortal body to bear.
vars.vrLm_bnkr_player_all_full: The wieght of a single other souls is to much for your mortal body to bear.
vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "~IGuh~I I don't have any place to put that.  Now if it were shillings...~n~k"

vrDesc: Once thought to be a creature made up to frighten children, the black spider is said to be a product of evil sorcery, an unwholesome melding of human and insect.  Its origin, however, is different depending on the story.  In some, it is the fate of some poor soul who crossed a dark mage.  In others, the dark spider is an evil mage transformed in return for longevity.  All the old tales, however, warn travellers to beware of this malignant creature's extraordinarily poisonous bite.
A mature dense tree ready for harvesting.
Before you stands a woman, neither young nor old.  She carries about her a feeling of power and dignity.  You find it hard to stare at her for long periods of time.
A giant hunk of rock, possibly containing usefull ore.

These small lizards look exceptionally friendly.  Their gossamer wings allow them to jump into the air and take flight for brief periods of time.  When backed into a corner, dragonflies are known to have a nasty spitting attack.
The other dragonflies seem to revere this oddly colored female.  She looks up at you out of curiosity or hunger, you are not sure which.

vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s cocks its head quizzically and sniffs your hand.~n~k

vrDesc: Although dressed very regally in his best officer's uniform, this guard of the keep probably wouldn't be a serious challenge should war break out.  He's nowhere near as big and burly as the members of the Duke's Honor Guard.

The air around the rat is dark and thick with evil.  The smell of death and disease linger on its fetid breath as it darts towards its target.  The origins of this abomination are unknown.  The only definite knowledge known is of the deadly poison it carries in its bite.
Dragons are supposed to be mythical! It isn't fair!

A creature of living earth, this towering monster stalks toward you, causing the ground to shake with every step.  Its every move sounds like grinding stone, and the aroma of fresh soil fills your nostrils.
A giant hunk of rock, possibly containing usefull ore.

A primordial spirit flows through the dark branches of this ancient being.  A forest scent of aged wood and fertile earth tingles your nostrils.  You wonder if the story that it can summon lightning bolts to protect the forest is really true.
Feeding upon the dredges of the tainted soil in the land, this living tree exudes evil, its sap blackened with hate.

Hair unkempt and anger barely checked.  Some say she is on the brink of madness, others say she is a terrible menace waiting to be released like a raging storm.  She despises civilization and feels humans must return to the ways of the wilds.

vars.vrTeach_message: From Faren's fire, you can learn %s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s at that level.
vars.vrTeach_quest_needed: To learn that, you must first become my disciple by proving the strength of your faith.

vrDesc: This creature is a mass of pure elemental energy.  You feel a powerful heat emanating from its immense body.  Its movements crackle like hungry flames.
This gigantic golem seems to be made entirely out of fire.
Fortuna spends her time collecting ancient coins lost by other pirates. If you find any ancient doubloons I'm sure she will give you something useful in return.
This is a frogman, a gentle race of amphibioids. They are known for their hatred of those who follow the evil path.
This strange creature, made up of tender, pulpy flesh, moves slowly and deliberately.  Giant spores cling to its back.
The giant rat bares its yellow teeth in defiance.  A smell of rot emanates from its filthy coat.
The giant rat soldier bares its yellow teeth in defiance.  A smell of rot emanates from its filthy coat.
A fearsome and stealthy creature, the groundworm is known for its habit of lurking underground out of sight, then suddenly springing forth to devour its hapless victim.

A younger form of its mature relatives, the larva is a bit weaker than other groundworms. It is known for its habit of lurking underground out of sight then suddenly springing forth to attack its victim.

The largest of the groundworms, the queen is a feared monster.  After growing over long periods of time, groundworms need increasing amounts of food to sustain themselves.  The queens are driven mad by an overwhelming desire to consume food to satiate their immense hunger.  Occasionally groundworm queens lay eggs in corpses that hatch into groundworm larva.
Before you stands the stately guild hall executor. Frular has made a healthy profit off of selling official guild titles, maintenance of their charters and the leasing of guild halls.

vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "Thou canst pay thy rent only with shillings!~n~k"

vrDesc: Met with a gruesome death, this knight has unfinished business.

Outcast by the religious community due to her blasphemous views of the gods, Miriana dances by herself far from the rigid walls of civilization.  Some call her a heretic, others a child, but all seem to find something dangerous about the distant girl.
This druidic mage's demeanor is so calm and peaceful that you can't help but wonder why his ghostly shade still walks this plane.
A penetrating cold wafts over you from this creature, chilling you to the bone.  Frost coats the ground with each of its steps, and the very air around it seems heavy with icy fog.

Izzio carries his massive sack and bulging belly with surprising ease and grace.  A beatific grin and blissful eyes speak to Izzio's simple joy with nature.  Unfortunately Izzio's Zen-like communion with the natural does not temper his obsessive pursuit of profit.

With long, wavy blonde hair framing her gentle face, the priestess of song greets you with a thoughtful gaze and a warm smile.  Clad in robes of fine silk dyed in the vibrant colors of her order, Themalas elegant appearance belies the dedication and effort behind her role.  Born to noble parents and trained in music, art, and courtly ways from childhood, Themala chose to earn her place through courage and perseverance.  She joined the city guard at fifteen, aspiring to become a royal bard in King Aaron's court.  Her gift for inspiring allies with stirring songs soon reached the king, who recognized her talent and appointed her priestess, that she might teach others the secrets of the lute.

vars.vrTeach_quest_needed: To learn that, you must first become my disciple by proving the strength of your faith.

vrDesc: Yevitan studies you with thoughtful, intelligent eyes.  He is surprisingly spry for his age.

vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "~IGuh~I I don't have any place to put that.  Now if it were shillings...~n~k"

vrDesc: A peevish and sullen man tends this bar.  This is Pietro, the impetuous sot.

vars.vrUnwanted_keep: ~k%s%s tosses the item into the garbage and sneers, "Get lost.~n~k"
vars.vrUnwanted_pay: ~k%s%s tells you, "I'll give you a couple schillings for that, my mother's birthday is coming up.~n~k"
vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "What do I look like, a freggin' junk buyer?  There's no soliciting here so get out of my bar with your flim-flam, stranger.~n~k"

vrDesc: Quintor is widely recognized as the finest weaponsmith in the land.  He is also recognized as a quiet, brooding man who keeps to himself.  Take that as you will.

Afiera D'xor spent many, many years of solitude in these mountains, and now devotes his life to his art.  His stone carvings are intricate designs of mathematical perfection.  He will make time, however, to entertain travellers who hope to share some of the wisdom he has gained from a life of secluded meditation.

vars.vrUnwanted_keep: ~k%s%s tells you, "Perhaps I may find some use for that.~n~k"
vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "Most material goods are of little consequence to an old man like me.~n~k"

vrDesc: The Widow Qesino has run the Yonder Inn since her late husbands' disappearance.  She seems to be a very straightforward if rather plain woman.
Zhieu B'hob works very hard to make his business thrive in this depressed community.  He is eager, and busy with the appearances.

The cousin of Obert Cair'bre, Rolan has taken the family business south.  Though as he diligently serves the people of Jasper, his big city demeanor is often at odds with the townsfolk's more rebellious attitude.

vrDesc: He is quiet and anti-social and can barely make it a few minutes in conversation before his hampering stammer kicks in.  Aside from being a little slow due to sleep deprivation he is generally quite perceptive.  He notices little details and can draw good conclusions from them.

Rosaline spent her early days in her father's smithy, helping him out where she could and, being a quick learner, picking up the craft along the way.  Possessing a curious mind, Rosaline dedicated most of her spare time to the study of the living creatures around her and, in doing so, developed a particular fascination with beetles and their multi-colored shells.  Using her observations as an inspiration, she soon began investigating new methods to create uniquely colored alloys that her father could use in his work. When he fell victim to a mysterious illness and died several years later, the responsibility of carrying on with the family's business fell on her shoulders.  Never one to complain, she picked up where her father had left off and has since made a name for herself and her extraordinary abilities.

A man with a warm, jovial air about him, he loves to listen to people at length before talking their ear off.  He can carry on conversation for hours often by his passion of the theatre.  Jorgan is always cheerful,  even with a hangover, he considers everything a fun event and doesn't hold grudges. He works hard and plays hard.
A well armored knight of a long forgotten legion.
Zala is a slow moving woman who obviously enjoys the earthly pleasures.  She talks in a soft, husky voice between long drags on her clay pipe.

Well respected as the master of all monetary affairs on the island, Huital pays close attention to the economy and how it relates to every business.  Before engaging in any new transaction of coins, he quickly washes his hands in the pedestal of clear water.

vrDesc: After losing his right arm in action at Balo na'te Din, Oxal was discharged from service with the Ko'catan Army and assigned to The Barking Monster.  It is a great honor to be the veteran selected to run this military owned establishment, but Oxal performs the work with little apparent relish.

This powerful woman has established herself as the pre-eminent weaponsmith in the warrior society of Ko'catan. She has also established herself as a woman with a gift for speaking the most colorful parts of the Ko'catan language.

This female Avar has been exiled from her society for her illegal magic practices.  At least that's the common belief, although it is difficult to determine if any reason can be applied to this strange creature.

vrDesc: This becoming, young woman appears as cold and curt to new faces.  Despite that, it is obvious to all that her true passion lies in the crafting of fine bows.

vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "I have enough of those type of supplies to hold us through the summer.~n~k"

vrDesc: Entrepreneurial by nature, Moxal ix'Hanak is always on the look out for a new high risk investment.  He greets you with a confident smile and a clandestine gleam in his eye.

vars.vrUnwanted_keep: ~k%s%s tells you, "Thank you.  You won't regret letting me borrow that.~n~k"

vrDesc: Brilliant yet begrudged by most of the island for his age, this high pitched youth rose from an annoying bookworm to one of the most sought after individuals due to his extensive knowledge of languages. He regards most of the adults around him as intellectual inferiors who cannot appreciate his mind.

vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "Very interesting, but I don't need it.~n~k"

vrDesc: Leering at you as if you were a potential subject for some twisted experiment, Bahal smiles and chortles to himself.  The moody little man seems unnaturally obsessed with the horrific and the bizarre.
Trained to defend the walls of Ko'catan this soldier is ready to prove his mettle.

This somewhat scattered man runs a very scattered store set in an abandoned arsenal.  Regardless of his apparent lack of organization, Pacal has a remarkable understanding of exactly what is here and where.
Tepal's quick, furtive eyes give away the abundant and nervous energy which occupies him. Something about him tells you that he has good reason to be nervous.

Itzal's often rude attitude and awkward bodily noises make him far lesspopular than his fraternal twin, Huital.  With a labored sigh and a piggish grunt, he begrudgingly accommodates the needs of those who wish to store items in the vault.

An older man who is obviously blind in both eyes. With his every move exacting and his every word said with forethought, this former warrior defines the slow grace of a seasoned hunter. Noted for his keen ear, some say he can hear those things that make no noise, like a frown or a doubting thought.

Qerti'nya is very judgemental of the strength of those who come before her.  Blood and hellfire are the tools of this priestess, for only the strong and good meaning deserve to live.  She is quick to make accusations or statements.  Although she delivers a powerful sermon, she is likely to go out drinking with the men after it is over.

vars.vrTeach_message: Through rigorous discipline, I can teach you %s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s at that level.
vars.vrTeach_quest_needed: To learn that, you must first become my disciple by proving the strength of your faith.

vrDesc: This spindly-legged creature scuttles along the jungle canopy in search of unsuspecting prey, which includes just about everything that moves. Island travellers are warned to keep careful watch above, for the deadly grinning lizards have been known to decapitate a grown man in a single blow with their dagger-sharp claws.

This underwater denizen, although hideous and brutish, is rumored to be peaceful in nature, but there is no evidence of that now.  The lupoggs seem upset that their territory has been trespassed upon, and seem eager to challenge any they can find.

There is no overlooking Tova, a bellowing and uproarious man who takes life exactly as it comes through the front door of the Limping Toad.  He is the proprietor here, serving drinks and entertaining from his self-styled rostrum noted for its powerful stout.

vars.vrUnwanted_keep: ~k%s%s tells you, "Well, how nice of you.  A gift.~n~k"
vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "Ha, ha, you've got to be kidding me, stranger! This is a tavern, not a gypsys tent!~n~k"

vrDesc: A country blacksmith with years of pounding the anvil ringing in his ears, Colhorr is an established landmark in Marion.  Most of his work consists of fabricating and repairing farming implements and hardware for the agrarian locals.

vars.vrUnwanted_pay: ~k%s%s tells you, "Well it certainly looks valuable!~n~k"
vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "Don't waste my time with that.~n~k"

vrDesc: An ancient member of the Marion community, Ran er'Hoth has taken on a somewhat legendary status throughout Meridian, and is sought out for his opinions and knowledge by pilgrims and travellers.  Whether he is considered a wise man or the village idiot locally really depends on who you talk to.
In the presence of Lady Aftyn there is no mistaking that she is of royalty, and not from these parts.  She exudes a sense of peaceful determination; of confidence, serenity, and purpose.

A silly little man, Morrigan maintains a modest business alternately buying and selling reagents and other various notions.  Although his heart doesn't seem to be in commerce, there can be little doubt Morrigan loves his job.
A towering monster with the body of a man and the head of a bull.

Parrin is widely known across the land, but rarely spoken of favorably.  Although extremely gifted with the lyre, this travelling minstrel's lyrics and puns habitually bring groans of disgust from those who are forced to listen.  Rumor has it that Paddock has threatened to kill Parrin should he ever set foot in Familiars again.  For a generous tip, he may sing of your exploits.  For a bigger tip, he may even leave.

A recent arrival to the lands, this giant creature is rather peaceful.  It roams the area, looking for food.  It rarely attacks people unless it is attacked first.  But, be warned, its thick shell and powerful claw make it a tough foe to face.
Unable to find peace, this poor, forsaken soul wanders dark and endless corridors, waiting to be judged at last.  Its flesh is putrid and soft, and its eyes ask for rest from its cursed unlife.
Unable to find peace, this poor, forsaken soul wanders dark and endless corridors, waiting to be judged at last.  Its flesh is putrid and soft, and its eyes ask for rest from its cursed unlife.

In spite of its otherworldly hideousness, the narthyl worm's lithe movements are intensely hypnotic.  Every nerve in your body is screaming danger, ringing dully through the trance-like state that seems to be descending over your mind.

Transfixed under the unearthly stare of this foul being, your mind skitters fearfully around the thought of the dark rituals which must have transformed it into what it is.  Indeed, the necromancer is an unliving testimonial to the terrible price of magical power.
A giant hunk of rock, possibly containing usefull ore.

Despite their diminutive frame, nyrphlings have no shortage of ways to torment their adversaries.  With their razor-sharp claws, venomous fangs and deadly stingers, these fiery creatures make for fearsome opponents - especially when encountered in groups.  If taken on individually, however, an experienced adventurer may dispatch them before they are able to do much harm.
This huge creature drives fear into the heart of anyone  who comes across it. Ogres are known to be much more  violent then friendly.
This foul servant of Qor, body covered in filth, towers above human height.  It fiercely grips a blade in one gnarled hand.

Harnessing dark powers from deep underground, the Orc Wizards enforce the mandates of their chieftain, such as extermination of the enemy shadow beasts.  How the orcs came upon the powers of magic is unknown, but the thought of man's greatest enemy armed with arcane power is enough to make any warrior queasy.
A giant hunk of rock, possibly containing usefull ore.
Doing his best to look as stately as the royalty that he is charged to protect, this guard wears his uniform with pride.  A sense of security fills the air in the area around the courtly guard.

The perfect servant of Qor the Vile.  Shadows deepen where this malevolent woman stands.  She has a devious sensuality that she will exploit to turn men and women to succumb to the dark will of Qor.  If she can not seduce others to Qor, she would rather see them dead.

vars.vrTeach_message: Through the darkness of Qor, you can learn %s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s at that level.
vars.vrTeach_quest_needed: To learn that, you must first become my disciple by proving the strength of your faith.

vrDesc: A giant hunk of rock, possibly containing usefull ore.

As the quartermaster of the ship he keeps a log of all the boats treasures. If you have the coins perhaps you can take some of his hands. Altho pirates only deal in silver coins, Moxal ix'Hanak is known for selling rare metals.
These primitive reptilian-like creatures rest in murky waters and like to use superior numbers to overwhelm their prey
A strange man of unknown origin, Ravi is always willing to buy reagents and gems for his inventory-poor shop.

As a self-proclaimed disciple of the goddess Shal'ille, Gamos has made it his holy mission to spread the blessed teachings of fiscal responsibility to the masses - and where better to start than in the quaint town of Raza with its near endless supply of young and impressionable adventurers ready to spread the gospel.  Enthusiastically embracing his role as a mentor, he never tires of familiarizing his 'acolytes' with important theological concepts such as 'wicked be the poor' or 'no loans'.

vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "~IGuh~I I don't have any place to put that.  Now if it were shillings...~n~k"

vrDesc: Despite his professional demeanor and fashionable barkeeping attire, Eric's spirits truly soar when it comes to his true passion: cooking.  He is especially renowned for his delicious soup and always on the lookout for fresh ingredients.

As a maker of unremarkable but reliable weapons and armor, Tomas earns his customers with good comradeship and low prices.  A fine warrior in his days, Tomas is known to gladly share his knowledge in the art of battle with any young adventurer who would be interested in picking up a blade to defend the land.  He may also be of help, should you wish to forget what you have learned of weaponcraft, so that you may fully dedicate yourself to the study of magicks.  Most people agree, however, that even a mage would do good knowing how to dodge a blow.

The old man looks back at you with eyes that have seen beyond forever. He is famous for his knowledge of various magicks and seems quite willing to teach some of them to aspiring adventurers. You may also ask him about a school of magic if you need help with freeing your mind from its teachings, so that you may be more successful in learning others.
A veteran of the Orc Wars, Marcus now seems content to settle into his new life running a small and quiet country inn.

vars.vrNothing_for_sale: I don't have anything to sell myself, but ask around - some of the other folks around here do.

vrDesc: A gruff old man with untamed white hair, Bentu seems to handle the heavy crates stacked in his vault with remarkable ease.  A mischievous twinkle is dancing in his eyes as he rests his gaze upon you and you can't quite make up your mind whether you should be unsettled or not.

vars.vrVaultman_nocursed: Are ye insane?  No way I'll let ye use my vault fer %s cursed %s!
vars.vrVaultman_fullvault: I don't have any more space fer ye things!
vars.vrVaultman_dont_have: Huh, ye sure %s%s is somewhere in here?
vars.vrVaultman_no_room: Now look at ye trying t' carry all of that garbage!  Maybe take one thing at a time?
vars.vrVaultman_withdraw_failed: Huh?  Something's not quite right...  Gimme a moment!
vars.vrVaultman_nodeposit_cash: My services ain't free.  Get %i shillings or get lost!
vars.vrVaultman_cant_part: This %s looks like trouble!  Keep it.
vars.vrVaultman_not_enough: Are ye trying t' fool me?  Ye never gave me that many %s!

vrDesc: The exoskeleton of the mutant ant is thick and hard and its mandibles sharp and deadly.  It is stronger and more vicious than its dark skinned cousin.
This plant is completly taken over by silk worms! I'm sure I can gather raw silk from it.
A mature tree ready for harvesting.

Floating several feet above the ground, this enigma of a being watches you.  When it speaks, the monk's voice crackles like century old parchment. You have a very uneasy feeling that all is not as it seems.

vars.vrDesc2: With a sickly sweet child's voice and an unwholesome look of innocence, the priestess of Riija welcomes you to her inner sanctum of unreality.
vars.vrTeach_message: Through ~I~rRiija's madness, ~byou can learn %s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s at that level.
vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "~BFool,~I I do not need anything from ~n~r~Byou~n~k"
vars.vrTeach_quest_needed: To learn that, you must first become my disciple by proving the strength of your faith.

vrDesc: A giant hunk of rock, possibly containing usefull ore.
A giant hunk of rock, possibly containing usefull ore.
The scorpion's deadly stinger rises high in the air and its hard plated body protects it from all but the strongest attacks.

A magical abomination that hybrids the jungle kriipa with some quasi-substantial entity from the nether world.  Residual Qor magic seems to make the air darker when this foul beast is near.  Although they mainly prey on cave orcs, the shadowbeast have been known to kill humans on occasion.
Clean and prim, this priestess of peaceful serenity speaks only kind words.  She even wishes peace on those of Qor and prays for their redemption.

vars.vrTeach_message: The benevolence of Shal'ille offers %s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s at that level.
vars.vrTeach_quest_needed: To learn that, you must first become my disciple by proving the strength of your faith.

vrDesc: A few scraps of rotten flesh cling to this collection of bones.  The skeleton, although lifeless, is animated by dark magicks.
A mass of quivering goo, the slime inches forward leaving a sickly trail behind.  The remains of its last victim are visible within its transparent innards.
The small rat bares its yellow teeth in defiance.  A smell of rot emanates from its filthy coat.
This is the ice-born cousin of the mainland vermin.  It is less disgusting by nature, but by far a more challenging foe.

This poor creature was once a person who was mummified in an ancient ritual and put to rest in the crypt.  Ages have passed and only the spirit of the original person remains.  It has been dead and mummified for so long it has forgotten what it originally looked like and now wanders this plane as a spectral being, appearing as it did when it was originally put to rest.
This strangely delicate creature moves with stealth and strikes with deadly precision.
Smaller and weaker than his larger kin, this baby spider is deadly nonetheless.   Its soft belly is engorged with its last meal.

The heavily armored spinebeast tends to be a peaceful creature, yet it is known for fiercely defending its young against anything it may perceive as a threat.  Travellers are advised to keep their distance as the spinebeast's spines and deadly horn can cause gruesome injuries.

Adorable yet fierce, the spine beast is ready to charge at any evil doer who would dare to challenge its territory in order to prove its might to the rest of the herd.  Even though a young spine beast may not be the toughest opponent on its own, adventurers are well advised to keep a look out for stronger specimens who may come to the young one's aid.
Given the ominous task of guarding the Heart of Zjiria, this stone troll glares darkly at all those passing by.  You have a feeling you better start running.
Both a spirit and the sentinel of the swamp, there is something puzzling about this tree, as she watches faithfully.

The powerful smell of rotted flesh and embalming herbs assault your nostrils.  This shambling horror in front of you seems like it was crafted in madness, and birthed in nightmares. Various limbs, none of them matching, sprout from this monster in disarray, and in its eye a strange malignance glows.  Run for your life.

This sickly man stares at you with bleary eyes from behind the counter.  His breathing is somewhat labored and sweat mattes his forehead.  Frisconar is almost as well known for his keen interest in magical reagents as he is for his dour out look on life.

vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "What is this?  I don't want it!  It's probably cursed.~n~k"

vrDesc: Skivlat spends all of his time in the company of money and it shows.  His hand lovingly caresses the gold as a large doting smile forms on his face.  Every so often he will jingle the bag just to hear the melodious clinking of shillings.

vars.vrUnwanted_give: ~k%s%s tells you, "~IGuh~I I don't have any place to put that.  Now if it were shillings...~n~k"

vrDesc: As owner of perhaps the most popular bar in the world, Paddock goes out of his way to smile at every customer who comes through the door.  His down to earth demeanor and common man approach to his clientele makes him one of the most likeable men in Tos.
Covered with knots of lumpy flesh, the troll has powerful arms and razor sharp talons.

A few scraps of rotten flesh cling to this collection of human bones topped by a skull with large tusks protruding from its mouth.  You shudder to think what dark ritual brought this abomination into being.
A giant hunk of rock, possibly containing usefull ore.

Veydran Goldleaf is the shrewd and silver-tongued master of the bustling players' market in Barloque. A seasoned merchant with a sharp eye for value, he ensures that trade flows smoothly while always securing a favorable deal for himself. With his elegantly tailored robes, he exudes an air of refinement that sets him apart from the common traders.Rumors whisper that he once served as a court treasurer before vanishing under mysterious circumstances, only to reappear years later in Barloque, where he carved out his dominion over the marketplace. Some say he still has ties to powerful figures, subtly influencing trade and politics in ways that benefit his own secretive interests. Despite his reputation for being a tough negotiator, Veydran is fairso long as one respects the rules of commerce. Those who try to cheat him or disrupt the balance of the market soon find themselves blacklisted, or worse, on the receiving end of consequences only whispered about in back alleys.To adventurers, Veydran is a valuable contact, offering rare goods, insider knowledge, and lucrative dealsprovided they have the coin or something equally enticing to offer in return.
A Wolf

Before you is a Xeochicatl, a fearsome monster given life by the chaotic magic of the Meridian.  The Xeochicatl is the embodiment of destruction, a violent monster that seems uncontrollable.  These monsters feed off of the magic of the lands which makes them very powerful.  Rumors abound about the origin of these monsters, but you have little time to contemplate these rumors in the presence of such destructive power!

Zimmucas was a well traveled hunter in the old days. Now he spends his time in the desert hunting elemental monsters. Tho the land in barren and can lead to loneliness, he spends time on the pirates ship chatting and selling his spoils and sending adventurers on quest.
Unfettered evil has brought the dead back to life in the form of this zombie.  Rotten flesh, white and pulpy, clings to soft bone.  Its watery eyes stare out, unseeing.

A remarkable man fallen upon a tough life, Wulfgang was born on the mainland and raised in the persecuted secret society of the last Riija School.  Besides that he somehow escaped to this island and established his trading post, little else is known about Wulfgang's past.
